mainEntity.name: Does the EU AI Act apply if we're outside the EU?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can, for example when you sell to EU users or your enterprise customers do. Start with risk-tier classification of your AI systems and confirm obligations with counsel.

mainEntity.name: Who should own AI governance inside the organisation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A named executive owner with a cross-functional group spanning risk, legal, IT, data and the business. Governance owned only by IT or only by legal tends to stall.
